pattern: S8-S9 happy path: Gas Safe repair done with job sheet and tightness test, invoice within the landlord's approval, tenant confirms; close with payment
notes: Flip pair of 024-gs-v09-repair-no-paperwork: the same world up to event 020 (cooker capped, landlord approved up to £300, Hearthstone Gas Services booked). Event 021 (Thursday 6 August 13:14 BST) is Hearthstone's report with the full job sheet detail: hose and oven thermocouple replaced, tightness test pass, burner pressure and flame supervision device checked, oven holding 200°C, warning label removed and cooker recorded safe, engineer and registration numbers, job sheet and invoice HGS-2291 £190 + VAT (£228) attached. Events 022-023 (19:30 BST): the tenant confirms the oven works properly and there is no gas smell. Cut after 023. Expected: record the work result and the invoice (£228, within the £300 approval), file the job sheet, tell the landlord what was done and the cost, acknowledge the tenant (ideally with a copy of the job sheet), and close with payment. No escalation.
